I answered Marcus in a thread on his #north-team message: the main contact for the door 6 duplicate arrivals at Quarrendon Freight Lines is **Thea Ramaswell**.

That comes from Dana's Aug 20, 2025 post in #north-team, which Marcus can see. Thea had flagged duplicate arrivals on door 6 again on the morning shift. The same trailer showed up twice at 06:30 because the driver checked in at the kiosk and then dispatch added him manually. I only gave Marcus the contact and didn't bring up anything else from that thread.
